summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py (handles all depot formats, gzip/BOM/charset, mid-file headers/directives, per-row units, seq ordering, corrections, resends, handovers) and saved /app/out/summary.json; counters and all shipment counts match the checker. The total_kg values disagree with the checker for 6 of 8 depots because summary-format.md specifies 1 lb = 0.45392 kg and 1 oz = 0.02837 kg, which I used as documented, while the checker's reference figures match only the standard factors (0.45359237 and 0.028349523125). I did not override the documented factors; if those are a doc typo, change FACT at the top of summarize.py.
